steps.text: 11:20 P.M. \ Overcast
Outside Immigration Department, L.G.D. Headquarters 2nd Floor, Upper Lungmen.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, something's wrong. Don't you think it's strange that we were able to enter the headquarters so easily?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: There were so many Reunion forces outside so we braced ourselves for a hard fight, but it was as if they were sleepwalking.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: According to our scouts' intel, their equipment is practically damaged to the point of unusability. It's unlikely that they've seen much combat, and their degree of preparedness seems...

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: It creeps me out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've noticed as well. They don't even know we're here. At least they're not a threat right now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll follow the plan. Next, our non-combat squads will scout out the distribution of Reunion forces on each floor, and attempt to restart the security system that was disabled earlier.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Additionally, we'll need to be ready to hold off a possible Reunion encirclement. We must hold out until our plan is implemented smoothly.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Focus your attention on controlling the situation inside.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: According to our sources, Reunion's temporary command center is on the rooftop.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The rooftop? What kind of leader would put their command center on the roof?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmm... there's a significant possibility of this being a trap.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: But we don't have a choice, do we, Madam?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's right. Taking back the rooftop would be like lighting Lungmen's signal beacon. We will let Reunion witness the moment when the L.G.D. Headquarters returns to our hands.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We ought to lead them all here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get ready, there are still a few hours to go. Let the recon and engineer squads go first. The combat squads still have some time to rest up before the main operation begins.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't waste even the smallest opportunity to create an advantage. Expect our enemies to fight to the death.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, something doesn't feel right about this building.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Let me make a conjecture first. As we get closer to the top floor, we may encounter some resistance. Perhaps there are some enemies stationed on the roof.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: However, the lower floors were completely empty. Only on the sixth floor did enemies start to appear, and while their numbers have increased, they haven't posed any threat.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Just now, one of my squad members reported that he thought he saw some Reunion members walk down a corridor, but they disappeared in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Another member told me that he heard some whispering, but when he went to investigate, he didn't find anything.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: That's all we found from our investigation. But something feels wrong to me still.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's go first. I don't have time for your nonsensical ghost stories.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Even if there was something anomalous going on, I'll handle it after this is all over.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Yes ma'am!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's take the fire escape route here. Though we don't it often, it's going to come in handy now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This staircase will take us straight to the rooftop.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You'll all control the top floor and use your vision advantage to cover me. I'll head directly to the rooftop, and rejoin you after the situation is stabilized.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, are you really going alone? Whatever the situation is, I'm sure we'll be able to help.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have full confidence in your abilities. However, I might have to go all out in this coming battle.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The most you can do to help me is to clear Reunion out of this entire building, and make sure I have nothing else to worry about.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: In that case, we won't get in your way, Madam Ch'en. Lungmen is counting on you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wrong. Lungmen is counting on us.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hurry!
Good evening, Madam.
You charged straight into my trap alone. Should I call you brave, or just stupid?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You have no where to run, Reunion commander.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Is that so? From my perspective, Madam, you are the one who has nowhere to run. My comrades shall devour you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talk is cheap. Show me what you've got.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You should never have set foot here, Reunion!
